subject.title: feat(workspace): add tiered bootstrap loading with configurable bootstrapTier

question: Should OpenClaw accept agents.defaults.bootstrapTier as a core config surface now, and should full be the only tier that admits bootstrap-extra-files hook additions?
rationale: The code path is bounded, but this changes prompt/session context policy and public config semantics, which automation cannot safely choose for maintainers.

options.title: Sponsor the PR shape after cleanup
options.body: Proceed with this additive defaults-only config design after fixing resolver semantics and public docs, preserving no-override compatibility.

options.title: Fold into broader context selection
options.body: Pause this PR and design one larger bootstrap/context selector that also covers related prompt-pressure and session-filtering issues.

options.title: Decline the config knob
options.body: Keep existing filters and steer users toward bootstrap budgets, contextInjection, lightweight mode, or a future plugin/API design instead.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the PR shape after cleanup
recommendation.body: Proceed with this additive defaults-only config design after fixing resolver semantics and public docs, preserving no-override compatibility.
